newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares close down in cautious trading.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares close down in cautious trading.

text.p: * Secondliners continue to outshine blue chips
Manila shares closed lower on Wednesday on fears of a repeat of Monday's heavy selling, traders said.
"There are still lingering fears over Monday's fall and there's no sustainable good news, so the market lost yesterday's gains," said Noel Reyes, research head at Anscor-Hagedorn Securities Inc.
The main index closed 18.10 points lower at 3,171.88.
"Since the blue chips do not offer any play and they could be subject to foreign selling, local investors take refuge in speculative issues," said Manuel Goseco at Dharmala Securities (Phils) Inc.
Gaming firm Greater Asia Resources, for instance, rose 11.36 percent to 1.96 pesos a share.
Decliners outpaced advancers 61 to 47 with 71 issues unchanged. All sectors fell except the oil sector.
The index will likely move within the 3,150 to 3,200 point range for the rest of the week, traders said.
